summary: The diff addresses most of the 12 requirements. Key areas covered include: App.tsx routing fix (REQ-108), AdminGuard fix (REQ-113), useAdminSession credential fix (REQ-111), LoginPage admin/user mode separation (REQ-112), imageHelpers/getImageSrc usage in components (REQ-110), backend main.mo and migration.mo (REQ-109/REQ-114/REQ-116), useQueries hooks (REQ-115/REQ-116), DialogContent/DialogDescription additions in CartPage and CheckoutPage (REQ-118), and CSP/index.html (REQ-117). However, several requirements show gaps or are not evidenced in the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Audit and fix all compilation and runtime errors in backend/main.mo and backend/migration.mo. Ensure system func init() and system func postupgrade() execute without runtime errors.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows backend/main.mo uses system func preupgrade() and system func postupgrade() but does NOT show a system func init(). The requirement explicitly requires init() to execute without errors. Additionally, imports of MixinStorage, MixinAuthorization, and AccessControl modules are not shown to exist in the repo and may still cause compilation failures.

missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows upsertAdminSeeds() called from preupgrade() and postupgrade() but not from init(). No init() function is visible in the diff. The role-check guard implementation for write-protected functions is not visible in the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.reason: The file is truncated and the specific implementations of createTemplate, updateTemplate, deleteTemplate, createProduct, updateProduct, deleteProduct mutation hooks are not visible. Cannot confirm the authenticated actor is properly used in these specific mutations.
